text:
sarah.w: Heads up — audit-validator CI red on master after the RBAC schema change. 5 failing tests, mostly event mismatch for kms.key_used and actor.role fields.
raj: Can you paste the failing diff?
sarah.w: Copied from CI:
```
FAIL tests/test_validator.py::test_event_schema_kms
- expected: "kms.key_id"
+ actual: "kms.key_used"
... 3 more diffs
```
olivia: That looks like a field rename from the RBAC rollout — actor.role used to be 'role' and now 'actor.role'
mike.b: @sarah.w which commit introduced the schema change? PR or deploy?
sarah.w: Seems like #4583 — I think it adjusted the audit event shape for RBAC integration.
raj: I can reproduce locally. The golden fixtures were not updated. We should add a compatibility shim in the validator to accept both keys for a week.
sophie: +1 for shim. Also add a unit test for the shim and a migration note.
audit-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-0042 schema-regression-audit-validator
olivia: I'll open a quick PR for the shim and update the golden fixtures. tagging @security-eng for review.
mike.b: FYI we should also notify the Dedicated customers — this could break their audit parsers.
sarah.w: Agreed. I'll draft a short note for CS. Action items: olivia PR, raj tests, sarah notify CS, mike monitor.
olivia: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4721 — includes shim + tests + golden update :sparkles: 
raj: Running CI against that branch now.
raj: CI green on branch, merging in 10 if no objections.
sarah.w: Thanks team. Follow-up: add an integration test in nightly that validates both old and new shapes against golden fixtures.
mike.b: I'll add a checklist item in the deploy runbook to watch audit-validator CI for 24h post-merge.
olivia: Leaving a note in changelog: 'audit events: actor.role and kms.key_used accepted during rollout'
sarah.w: Closing loop — merged and rolled out. Keeping INC-2026-0042 open until customer confirmation.
